checks.detail: The same logical key name must not exist on the second VM before local creation.
Creating the same logical identity on a second VM must create a different key.
PKCS#8 private-key export must be rejected.
CNG ECC private-blob export must be rejected.
Existing Sisqual.Credentials entry encryption/decryption must work with the non-exportable CNG key.
An entry encrypted for machine A must not decrypt with machine B private key.
